note: Every source considered, what it is, how it may be used, and what SPADRA does with it. A source with status 'blocked' contributes no rule.

sources.title: Besluit bouwwerken leefomgeving (Bbl)
sources.licence_basis: Auteurswet art. 11 (no copyright in laws and decrees); official consolidation published openly.
sources.access: Official BWB XML repository (https://repository.officiele-overheidspublicaties.nl/bwb/BWBR0041297/<date>_0/xml/BWBR0041297_<date>_0.xml). Not reachable from the build environment, so the ingestion tool must run on a machine with network access.
sources.implemented: art. 4.180 lid 1 (clear width, clear height) with table 4.179
sources.verification: Transcribed from two secondary web publications (omgevingsweb.nl, inview.nl). Not yet verified against the official XML; run the verify command.

sources.title: Omgevingsweb (PONT Omgeving) article pages
sources.licence_basis: Publisher terms not reviewed. Used only to read the public-law text during transcription; nothing from the site is stored beyond numbers and article references.

sources.title: inView (Wolters Kluwer) article pages
sources.licence_basis: Publisher terms not reviewed. Used only to cross-check article numbers and figures; nothing from the site is stored.

sources.title: Bouw- en woningbesluit (AB 1999 no. GT 10)
sources.access: A PDF printout dated 22-10-2013 was found; it is machine-readable.
sources.blocked_reason: Legal status of the copy (is it the version in force? what does it bind?) and its reuse terms are unresolved. No Aruban threshold is implemented until they are.
sources.next_step: Obtain the consolidated text and its status from the Aruban legislation service (or the Departamento di Obra Públika / DOW), then run the ingestion workflow.

sources.title: ICC I-Codes (IBC, IRC) and ICC A117.1, as adopted by the AHJ
sources.authority: International Code Council; adopting Authority Having Jurisdiction
sources.licence_basis: ICC terms prohibit scraping, indexing and storing the code text.
sources.access: Licensed digital copy or purchase; not accessible to SPADRA.
sources.blocked_reason: Licensed content. Which edition and which local amendments apply is decided by the AHJ, so a single 'US dataset' would be wrong for most projects.
sources.next_step: Licensed-import workflow: the user supplies their own licensed export or the adopted values; SPADRA stores values and pinpoints they entered, never ICC text.

sources.title: 2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design (federal)
sources.note: A different instrument from the ICC codes requested, with its own applicability. Listed so the choice is visible; no value has been read or implemented.
